system_overview.model_overview: Model is based on finding Institutional Absorption OR strong Initiative Big Trades, and trading the Second Drive.
system_overview.ib_structure: Initial Balance (IB) / Initial Volume Breakout (IVB) is the first hour (60 mins) of trading. Breakout of IVB sets the day's trend bias. If price closes back inside the IB after a breakout, it is a failed auction (reversal). Target on breakouts is typically 1.5x to 2x the IB extension.
system_overview.day_types: Trend Day (one-sided directional move) vs Balance Day (rotates around POC). Do not trade inside the IB on a balance day. Do not trade if volume < 300.

liquidity_mapping_rules.stop_loss_placement: Stop Loss must be placed structurally behind HVNs (High Volume Nodes) or the defending Big Trade absorption wall. Standard Stop is 2-3 ticks behind the wall, Max 120 ticks.
liquidity_mapping_rules.take_profit_placement: Take Profit targets must prioritize being projected into LVNs (Low Volume Nodes) liquidity voids or opposite Value Area / Initial Balance extremes where price travels fast.

execution_rules.trigger_and_timing: Enter at MARKET immediately when Big Trades (look for 3+ Big Trades hitting the same level and failing to break it) hit a wall and are absorbed (Institutional Absorption), OR when strong Initiative Big Trades are rewarded by price acceptance. Do not wait for candle close (M5 or M1).
execution_rules.predatory_execution: Your entry must be within 10-20 ticks of the Big Trade cluster. Late entries are strictly prohibited. Invalidation occurs immediately if the Big Trade wall is breached (2-3 ticks behind).
execution_rules.big_trades_filter: Big trades must be >30 contracts to matter.
execution_rules.coherence: Ensure M5 trend, M1 delta, and Bookmap liquidity levels (HVN/LVN) align before entering.
execution_rules.counter_trend: Counter-trend setups are extremely dangerous and require a hard structural stop and clear absorption of the dominant trend. Fading strong one-timeframe moves is prohibited unless clear exhaustion is confirmed.

strategies.name: ivb_model_1_continuation
strategies.description: Trend continuation on a pullback to a key level (VAH/VAL, POC, LVN) after a confirmed Initial Volume Breakout (IVB) breakout
strategies.trigger: Price breaks outside the IVB range with institutional aggression, then retraces to a key level where sellers/buyers stall.
strategies.confirmation: Look for institutional absorption (large Big Trades, delta divergence) on the pullback, followed by a 'Second Drive' resuming the trend in the breakout direction.

strategies.name: momentum_squeeze
strategies.description: Trapped traders squeeze in trend direction
strategies.trigger: Aggressive participants hit a level (e.g. IB edge, swing extreme) but are absorbed by passive limits, trapping them.
strategies.confirmation: When price breaks past the trapped trader cluster, it triggers a fast liquidation squeeze. Stop is placed tightly behind the defending wall.

market_mechanics.punch_in_the_wall: On directional trend days, counter-trend aggression is absorbed at key levels: NEGATIVE DELTA at new HIGHS = sellers 'punching the wall' of institutional buyers (reload zone for longs). POSITIVE DELTA at new LOWS = buyers 'punching the wall' of institutional sellers (reload zone for shorts). Once price stabilizes (usually within 1-3 candles), enter the continuation. Never fade these punches on trend days; use them as continuation reload entry zones.
market_mechanics.imbalance_hunting: Below IB Low = SHORT trend. Above IB High = LONG trend. Do NOT fade an imbalance phase. Look for aggressive Big Trades in the breakout direction. Trapped vs Absorption: In explosive imbalance, positive Delta on down-candles represents passive buyers being ran over (absorption), not a reversal. Follow M1 momentum.
market_mechanics.initiative_vs_absorption: While passive absorption is a premium setup, you must also trade initiative setups. If strong initiative Big Trades (aggressive market orders) push price and the auction accepts the new level, enter in that direction and place SL behind the origin of those initiative Big Trades.
